requirements.text: API / Secret Manager is accessible from the AI Prompt OS Launcher and normal UI without requiring users to memorize PowerShell commands.
requirements.note: Launcherで通常操作可能。Browser側はReference-only表示までで、Desktop Secret Manager直接起動はWeb sandbox境界上未実装。

requirements.text: API secret values SHALL NOT be stored in BAT files, Repository files, Evidence, Browser localStorage, Browser persistent storage, or ordinary JSON configuration.
Browser-side components SHALL handle Secret Reference identifiers and metadata only; secret values remain Gateway / secure-host side.
The initial implementation MAY use process-scoped ephemeral environment references for development and validation.
Persistent secret storage, when introduced, SHALL use operating-system protected storage such as Windows Credential Manager / DPAPI or an equivalent secure mechanism.
requirements.note: v1はephemeral only。Windows Credential Manager / DPAPIはv2。

requirements.text: The Secret Manager SHALL support multiple providers without requiring provider-specific user command syntax.
The same provider MAY have multiple credential profiles, including ACTIVE, STANDBY, DISABLED, and RETIRED lifecycle states.
OpenAI shall remain one governed Provider / Source while allowing multiple OpenAI Secret References.
requirements.note: 複数OpenAI Reference選択は実装。登録済Sourceのcredential hot-switchは後続。

requirements.text: Initial OpenAI credential aliases SHALL support LEGACY and PRIMARY profiles without embedding account-identifying data in the aliases.
Credential switching SHALL NOT require re-creating the OpenAI Source Registry entry or Responses API Operation Contract when provider semantics are unchanged.
requirements.note: 登録済SourceのSecret binding差替えは未実装。

requirements.text: Each credential profile SHALL have an independent billing/usage attribution profile so cost and usage are not merged ambiguously across different API billing accounts.
requirements.note: CredentialごとのBilling Profile metadataは実装。実usage ledger attribution接続は後続。

requirements.text: The system SHALL distinguish Provider identity, Credential identity, Billing profile, Capability permission, and Budget authority.
requirements.note: Provider/Credential/Billing/Capability/Budget metadataは分離。Authorityとの完全統合は後続。

requirements.text: Possession of an API key SHALL NOT automatically activate paid usage, capability expansion, or budget expansion.
The default credential failover mode SHALL require an explicit governed policy rather than unrestricted automatic fallback.
A pre-approved failover policy MAY automatically switch between approved credentials only when destination credential, budget, provider, model/capability scope, and spend limits are already approved.
requirements.note: 自動failover自体をv1では無効化。

requirements.text: Without a pre-approved failover policy, exhaustion or failure of the active credential SHALL notify the Project Owner and stop before using a standby credential.
Provider-specific billing/quota errors SHALL be normalized so exhausted-credit conditions can be distinguished from authentication, rate-limit, network, and provider failures.

For OpenAI prepaid usage, the system MAY use provider-reported billing exhaustion signals such as credit_balance_exhausted as a failover trigger; it SHALL NOT assume local estimated balance is authoritative.
A positive or estimated remaining credit balance SHALL NOT be treated as an instantaneous hard spending cutoff.
The Secret Manager UI SHALL show Provider, credential alias, lifecycle state, active/standby role, last validation status, and associated billing/budget profile without revealing secret values.
The Secret Manager SHALL support manual credential switching with before/after impact display.
The Secret Manager SHALL support Capability OFF, Provider DISABLED, and Secret DISABLED/REMOVED as distinct stop levels.
requirements.note: Secret DISABLED/REMOVEDは実装。Capability OFF / Provider DISABLEDの実行層連携は後続。

requirements.text: Removing a secret from AI Prompt OS SHALL prevent local use but SHALL NOT be represented as provider-side revocation unless revocation was actually performed at the provider.
Provider-side key revocation remains a separate external-account action and SHALL be clearly distinguished in the UI.
API key rotation SHALL preserve audit lineage from old Secret Reference to replacement Secret Reference without preserving the old secret value.
No API key value SHALL appear in chat logs, validation output, audit records, Evidence, stdout/stderr, or UI state copies.

The API / Secret Manager SHALL integrate with existing Secret Governance, Source Registry, Gateway, Resource Budget, Usage Policy, Authority, and Audit components instead of creating duplicate subsystems.
requirements.note: 既存Gateway/Secret Governanceを再利用。Budget/Usage Policy/Authority/AuditのManager統合は後続。

requirements.text: Existing Decision 055 paid-activation, cost-risk UI, no-per-request-approval-inside-approved-scope, and fail-closed safety boundaries remain in force.

The current OpenAI LEGACY credential MAY be used until unavailable/exhausted, while a separately created PRIMARY credential MAY remain STANDBY with no paid usage until its own billing and budget authority are enabled.
Switching to a credential associated with a different API billing account SHALL require the destination billing profile and Budget to be active and compatible before paid execution.
requirements.note: 別Billing account切替時のBudget compatibility gateは後続。

requirements.text: Automatic recharge or external provider billing configuration SHALL NOT be changed by AI Prompt OS unless separately and explicitly authorized.
The design SHALL remain extensible to additional providers such as other AI, market-data, or broker APIs without weakening per-provider authority and cost boundaries.
